retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 3D metallic monogram centered over a deep purple starburst background with sharp beveled edges and gold accents.
excludeWhen: organic or hand-drawn textures are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A large, stylized 3D letterform dominates the frame, featuring a brushed silver metallic surface with thick gold beveled edges. The letter is set against a dark background with radiating purple light rays emanating from a central point behind the monogram.
coreVisualRelationships: Large central 3D monogram overlapping a radial starburst
Gold beveled edges contrasting with silver brushed metal faces
Deep purple glow emanating from the center of the composition
Secondary stylized text placed at the bottom of the primary monogram
coreInvariants: Thick 3D extrusion with distinct gold beveling
Radial light rays originating from a single central point

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary monogram is centered and occupies approximately 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central point of the purple starburst serves as the focal anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright center of the starburst outward along the metallic curves of the monogram.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, restricted to the corners where the dark background is visible.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between bright metallic highlights and deep black/purple shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Sharp, angular bevels on all edges
Integrated graphic elements like stars or crosses
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'i' or central vertical stroke is replaced with a stylized star-topped cross
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large abstract monogram paired with a smaller, more legible but still stylized wordmark.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides a square, futuristic base for 3D extrusion.
Captures the wide, tech-heavy aesthetic of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark background with a central purple starburst of thin radial lines. Place a large, abstract 3D 'C' shape in the center with brushed silver faces and thick gold beveled edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom 3D metallic lettering at the bottom center, following the curve of the main shape, using a silver fill and gold outline.

verificationChecks: Does the starburst originate from the center?
Are the gold bevels clearly defined against the silver?
Is the secondary text legible despite the 3D effects?

mustRedesign: Exact letterform of the secondary wordmark
postGenerationChecks: Verify radial symmetry of the background
Ensure no overlapping artifacts in 3D geometry
Confirm gold and silver color separation
recipe.reuseFormula: 3D [Letter] Monogram + Brushed Silver Face + Gold Bevel + Purple Radial Starburst Background
